swap.title: The contraction
swap.source:
contraction matmul
    (reads a: [f32; M, K])
    (reads b: [f32; K, N])
    -> out c: [f32; M, N] =
  c[i, j] = sum k. a[i, k] * b[k, j]

schedule swapped of matmul =
  zero (i, j) c
  hoist (j, k) c
swap.output:
fn swapped (reads a: [f32; M, K]) (reads b: [f32; K, N]) -> out c: [f32; M, N]
=
  for i in 0 .. M do
    for j in 0 .. N do
      var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
      for k in 0 .. K do
        acc'0 = fma (load a[i, k]) (load b[k, j]) acc'0
      store c[i, j] = acc'0
swap.note: Each output adds up its products in ascending order of k, starting from zero.

tiled.title: tiles (i, j, k) (16, 16) (8, 8)
tiled.source:
contraction matmul {S : Semiring}
    (reads a: [S.Value; M, K])
    (reads b: [S.Value; K, N])
    -> out c: [S.Value; M, N] =
  c[i, j] = sum k. a[i, k] * b[k, j]

schedule tiled of matmul @(S = PlusTimes f32) on M4Gpu =
  grid over (i, j)
  tiles (i, j, k) (16, 16) (8, 8)
tiled.output:
fn tiled (reads a: [f32; M, K]) (reads b: [f32; K, N]) -> out c: [f32; M, N]
requires
  M % 16 == 0,
  N % 16 == 0,
  K % 8 == 0
=
  grid on M4Gpu gi in 0 .. M / 16,
                gj in 0 .. N / 16
      by tile (si, sj) parts [8, 8]
      writes c[gi * 16 .. gi * 16 + 16, gj * 16 .. gj * 16 + 16] as ct_2 do
    var t: [f32; 16, 16] = repeat (-0.0)
    for k in 0 .. K / 8 do
      let x: [f32; 16, 8] = load a[gi * 16 .. gi * 16 + 16, k * 8 .. k * 8 + 8]
      let y: [f32; 8, 16] = load b[k * 8 .. k * 8 + 8, gj * 16 .. gj * 16 + 16]
      t = mma x y t
    store ct_2 = t
tiled.verdict:
tiled: bits of matmul_PlusTimes_f32
  arithmetic: M4Gpu
  trusted:
    template `simdgroup_mma8`
tiled.note: `tiles` groups the outputs into 16 × 16 tiles, one for each grid iteration, shared among four SIMD groups in 8 × 8 parts, and works through the sum eight steps of k at a time. t starts at zero and holds the tile's running totals across the k loop; x and y are the next pair of input blocks, and `mma` multiplies them and adds the product to t with the device's `simdgroup_mma8`.

tower.title: The contraction
tower.source:
contraction matmul {S : Semiring}
    (reads a: [S.Value; M, K])
    (reads b: [S.Value; K, N])
    -> out c: [S.Value; M, N] =
  c[i, j] = sum k. a[i, k] * b[k, j]

schedule tower of matmul =
  zero (i, j) c
  split k by 16 as gk ragged
  split i by 16 as gi, 4 as ui ragged
  split j by 8 as gj ragged
  order (gk, gj, gi, ui, i, j)
tower.output:
fn tower {S : Semiring} (reads a: [S.Value; M, K]) (reads b: [S.Value; K, N])
    -> out c: [S.Value; M, N]
=
  for i in 0 .. M do
    for j in 0 .. N do
      var acc'0: S.Value = S.zero ()
      for k in 0 .. K do
        acc'0 = S.mul_add (load a[i, k]) (load b[k, j]) acc'0
      store c[i, j] = acc'0
tower.note: The generic contraction, and the loop nest it means. Each output adds up its products in ascending order of k.

schedule packed of matmul @(S = PlusTimes f32)
    (mut packA: [f32; 16, 16] in PanelMajor 4 at DRAM)
    (mut packB: [f32; 16, 8] at DRAM) =
  zero (i, j) c
  split k by 16 as gk ragged
  split i by 16 as gi, 4 as ui ragged
  split j by 8 as gj ragged
  order (gk, gj, gi, ui, i, j)
  pack a into packA along gi over (a0, a1)
  keep packA along gi within L2 into packA_L2
  pack b into packB along gj over (b0, b1)
  keep packB along gj within L1 into packB_L1
  registers (i, j) into c rows 4 lanes 8 through fma
tower.output:
fn packed (reads a: [f32; M, K]) (reads b: [f32; K, N]) (mut c: [f32; M, N])
    (mut packA: [f32; 16, 16] in PanelMajor 4 at DRAM)
produces Init c
scratch packA
=
  for zi in 0 .. M do for zj in 0 .. N do store c[zi, zj] = -0.0

  for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
    for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
      for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
        for a0 in 0 .. gi.len do
          for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do store packA[a0, a1] = load a[gi[a0], gk[a1]]
        for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
          for i in 0 .. ui.len do
            for j in 0 .. gj.len do
              for k in 0 .. gk.len do
                let acc'0 = load c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]]
                store c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]] =
                  fma
                    (load packA[gi[ui[i]] - gi.lo, gk[k] - gk.lo])
                    (load b[gk[k], gj[j]])
                    acc'0

produces Init c

working_set
  @L2 { keep packA = descriptor packA }
movement
  traffic packA_pull = ceil (K / 16) * ceil (N / 8) * ceil (M / 16) *
    lines (span_bytes packA.span) from DRAM to L2 and back
=
  for zi in 0 .. M do for zj in 0 .. N do store c[zi, zj] = -0.0

fn sme (reads a: [f64; M, K]) (reads b: [f64; K, N]) (mut c: [f64; M, N])
    (mut packA: [f64; M, 3072] in PanelMajor 32)
    (mut packB: [f64; 3072, 256] in ColumnPanels 16 at DRAM)

  N % 256 == 0,

  M % 1536 == 0,
  M fits u64,
  M % 32 == 0,
  M fits u64,
  256 % 16 == 0,
  256 fits u64

=
  for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
    grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[pa * 32 .. pa * 32 + 32, 0 .. gk.len] do
      for ra in 0 .. 32 do
        for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
          store packA[0 + pa * 32 + ra, a1] = load a[0 + pa * 32 + ra, gk[a1]]
    for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
      grid pb in 0 .. 16 writes packB[0 .. gk.len, pb * 16 .. pb * 16 + 16] do
        for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
          for rb in 0 .. 16 do
            store packB[b0, 0 + pb * 16 + rb] =
              load b[gk[b0], gj * 256 + (0 + pb * 16 + rb)]
      grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
          writes c[gi * 1536 .. gi * 1536 + 1536, gj * 256 .. gj * 256 + 256] do
        for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
          for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
            let zero: Vec f64 (8 * 8) = splat (0 as f64)
            var blocks_2: [Vec f64 (8 * 8); 4 * 2] = repeat zero
            for b_2 in 0 .. ui.len / 8 * 2 do
              let at_row = 0 + gi * 1536 + ui[floor (b_2 / 2) * 8]
              let yj = 0 + gj * 256 + uj[0] + b_2 % 2 * 8
              blocks_2[b_2] =
                if gk.lo == 0 then splat (-0.0)
                else load c[at_row .. at_row + 8, yj .. yj + 8]
            for k in 0 .. gk.len do
              let rows: Mask 8 = prefix_mask 8
              let cols: Mask 8 = prefix_mask 8
              let column_all: Vec f64 32 =
                load packA[0 + gi * 1536 + ui[0] .. 0 + gi * 1536 + ui[0] +
                  32, gk[k] - gk.lo]
              let row_all: Vec f64 16 =
                load packB[gk[k] - gk.lo, 0 + gj * 256 + uj[0] - gj * 256 .. 0 +

                  uj[0] -
                  gj * 256 +
                  uj.len] else 0 as f64
              for q in 0 .. ui.len / 8 * 2 do
                let column: Vec f64 8 =
                  slice_lanes column_all (floor (q / 2) * 8)
                let row: Vec f64 8 = slice_lanes row_all (q % 2 * 8)
                blocks_2[q] =

              let yj = 0 + gj * 256 + uj[0] + b_2 % 2 * 8

flash.title: The contraction
flash.source:
contraction attend
    (reads q: [f32; 64, 16])
    (reads kt: [f32; 16, 32])
    (reads v: [f32; 32, 16])
    -> out y: [f32; 64, 16] =
  s[i, j] = sum c. q[i, c] * kt[c, j]
  y[i, d] =
    normalised (reduce[reassoc] Online j. key (s[i, j]) (v[j, d]))

schedule flash of attend on M4Gpu =
  split i by 32, j by 8, c by 16
  grid over i.outer
  compute s at j.outer
  reduce j.inner by (max: halving, sum: order)
  parts [8, 16]
  element [f32; 8, 8]
flash.output:
fn flash (reads q: [f32; 64, 16]) (reads kt: [f32; 16, 32])
    (reads v: [f32; 32, 16]) -> out y: [f32; 64, 16]
=
  for i in 0 .. 64 do
    for d in 0 .. 16 do
      var acc'1: Online.Value = Online.empty ()
      for j in 0 .. 32 do
        var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
        for c'0 in 0 .. 16 do
          acc'0 = fma (load q[i, c'0]) (load kt[c'0, j]) acc'0
        acc'1 = Online.combine acc'1 (key acc'0 (load v[j, d]))
      store y[i, d] = normalised acc'1

  arithmetic: M4Gpu
  trusted:

flash_shadow: equals attend over reals
  by:
    `Online` associative  over reals
    `Online` block        over reals
  trusted:
    `Online` associative: "(m, l, o) stands for (e^m l, e^m o), which combine adds"
    `Online` block: "a block's terms, each e^(s - m2) at the block's largest score m2, add to the summary rescaled to m2 as combine adds them"

These steps are shown together because the compiler needs the final `element` choice to construct the kernel.
